subject: Re-sizing leaflet maps makes Shiny unresponsive

messages.author: d8cf77de52e496bb
messages.subject: Re-sizing leaflet maps makes Shiny unresponsive
parts:
I've got a pretty basic Shiny app (see code below) that hangs whenever there's an event that triggers re-sizing of a previously hidden leaflet map. Here's one way to trigger the problem:

1) Run the app
2) Click on the second tab ("Leaflet2")
3) Hide sidebar panel by clicking "Full Screen" button
4) One more click in order to unhide the panel
5) Go back to "Leaflet1" tab

Results: grayed out leaflet map and unresponsive "Full Screen" button.

Debugging in Chrome shows an exception in the splitWithEscape function that gets called while trying to re-render the leaflet map.

Any help is appreciated.
Thank you,
   Yatzek


Here's the code 

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)

myApp <- shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    actionButton("fullScreen", "Full Screen", style="display:block; width:100%"),
    sidebarLayout(
      conditionalPanel(condition="(input.fullScreen %2 == 0)",
                       sidebarPanel(width = 3,
                                    dateRangeInput(inputId = "myDate", label="Date", 
                                                   start = "2015-01-01",
                                                   end = "2015-10-01", min = "2000-01-01", 
                                                   max = "2020-12-31", format = "yyyy-mm-dd",
                                                   startview = "month")
                       )),
      
      uiOutput("mainPanelUI")
      )
    ),
  server = function(input, output){
    myValues <- reactiveValues(
      selectedTab = "Leaflet1"
    )
    observeEvent(input$tabsetID, {
      myValues$selectedTab <- input$tabsetID
    })
    output$leaflet1 <- renderLeaflet({
      leaflet() %>% addTiles()
    })
    
    output$leaflet2 <- renderLeaflet({
      leaflet() %>% addTiles()
    })
    
    output$mainPanelUI <- renderUI({
      mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel( id='tabsetID', selected = isolate(myValues$selectedTab),
                     tabPanel("Leaflet1", leafletOutput("leaflet1", width = "100%", height = 600)),
                     tabPanel("Leaflet2", leafletOutput("leaflet2", width = "100%", height = 600))
        ), width = (9 + 3 * (input$fullScreen %%2)))
    })
    
  }
)

runApp(myApp)
